method: Every protected blob was streamed from git cat-file --batch and compared byte-for-byte with the working file; file modes also compared. SHA-256 is of those equal bytes. Filesystem enumeration includes ignored files within named roots.

bike_reader_reversal.allowed_changes: remove sampleMxFootField import; restore hasMxFootControls import; replace exactly three sampled foot reads with the original four-line reader block

ai_guard_reversal.allowed_change: three comment lines and removal of c.forceFront < d.mass * G * 0.38 gate only

preserved_runtime_law_regions.region: spring inverse, spring force and preload
yaw inertia and complete tyre shear law
all transport offsets, strides and protocol version

runtime.classification: three foot-state readers; model construction normalized separately
new pure recorded shift trajectory reader
recorded mechanical pose reconstruction and validation
motocross physical integration and controller lifecycle
accepted shift trajectory controller and derivatives
optional motion metadata in existing reserved tail

scope_caveat: Source/model protection is not a claim of identical non-MX behavior. A30 found two MX-on-road initial placement telemetry changes plus optional foot metadata; its nine exact scenario traces were measured before subsequent MX-only fixes. This audit does not rerun gameplay.
